40014154.author: पदार्थः
40014154.content: श्रीमान्: glorious, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, शोकपरिद्यूनम्: one who is filled with sorrow, दशरथात्मजम्: Dasaratha's son, तम्:  him, रामम्: at Rama, शोकनाशनम्: to remove the agony , वचनम्: words of advice, उवाच: spoke

40014154.author: Translation
40014154.content: Glorious Sugriva spoke such words of advice to remove the agony of Rama,son of Dasaratha, who was filled with sorrow.

40014155.author: पदार्थः
40014155.content: वीर: heroic, अन्यः like others , प्राकृतः common man, यथा: likewise, तथा: that way, त्वया: by you, किम्: why, तप्यते: give up grief, एवम्: that way, माभूः do not be, एवम: like this , कृतघ्नः ungrateful one, इव: like that, सन्तापम्: grief, त्यज: give up सौहृदम्: friendship

40014155.author: Translation
40014155.content: "Heroic Rama Why are you grieving like a common man? Give up your grief just like an ungrateful one gives up friendship."

40014156.author: पदार्थः
40014156.content: राघव: Raghava, प्रवृत्तौ: information , उपलब्धायाम्: having secured,ज्ञाते: knowing, चनिलयेरिपोः and the enemy's residence, सन्तापस्य: mourning, स्थानम्: location, नपश्यामिहि: I do not see the reason

40014156.author: Translation
40014156.content: "Raghava Having secured the information (of Sita) and known the location of the enemy's residence, I do not see the reason for your mourning."

40014157.author: पदार्थः
40014157.content: राघव: Raghava, मतिमान्: an intellectual, शास्त्रवित्: one who is well versed in Sastras, प्राज्ञः one who is wise, पण्डितश्चअसि: and who is learned also, कृतात्मा: one who is efficient, अर्थदूषणीम्: one who is a violator of subtle truth, बुद्धिम्:  intellect , इमाम्:  these, पापिकाम्: sinful, त्यज: give up

40014157.author: Translation
40014157.content: "Raghava You are an intellectual, well versed in Sastras, wise and learned. Give up this sinful thought just as the one who is efficient gives up the one who violates subtle truth."

40014158.author: पदार्थः
40014158.content: महानक्रसमाकुलम्: that which is infested with huge crocodiles, समुद्रम्: ocean, लङ्घयित्वा: if we cross over, लङ्काम्: Lanka, आरोहयिष्याम: ascending the fortress, ते: your, रिपुम्: enemy, हनिष्यामश्च: know that he is killed

40014158.author: Translation
40014158.content: "If we cross over that ocean infested with huge crocodiles and ascend the fortress of Lanka, know that the enemy is killed."

40014159.author: पदार्थः
40014159.content: निरुत्साहस्य: one who is despondent, दीनस्य: for a dejected person, शोकपर्याकुलात्मनः overwhelmed with grief, सर्वार्थाः in all matters, व्यवसीदन्ति: dispirited, व्यसनंच: and worry, अधिगच्छति: will be destroyed

40014159.author: Translation
40014159.content: "One who is despondent, dejected and overwhelmed with grief, will be dispirited in all matters. Not only that with worry he will meet with disaster."

40014160.author: पदार्थः
40014160.content: सर्वतः all these , इमे:  to you, हरियूथपाः vanara leaders, शूराः heroes , समर्थाश्च: highly capable, त्वत्प्रियार्थम् : for your happiness, पावकम्: fire, प्रवेष्टुम्: to enter अपि: also, कृतोत्साहः are ready, एषाम्: these, हर्षेण: joy, जानामि: I know, मम: me, तर्कश्चापि: even infer, दृढः I am certain

40014160.author: Translation
40014160.content: All these vanara leaders and heroes are highly capable and for your happiness they are even ready to enter fire. I know this from their joy and I even infer that it is certain (to happen).

40014161.author: पदार्थः
40014161.content: रिपुम्: enemy, पापकर्माणम्: one of sinful deeds, रावणम्: Ravana, विक्रमेण: with  prowess, हत्वा: on killing, सीताम्: Sita, यथा: that way, समानेष्ये: bring back, तथा: that way, त्वम्: your, कर्तुम्: will do , अर्हसि: you ought to

40014161.author: Translation
40014161.content: "You ought to work such that we would kill that enemy Ravana of sinful deeds with our prowess and get back  Sita. I hope you are capable of doing that."

40014162.author: पदार्थः
40014162.content: राघव: Raghava, अत्र: there, सेतुः  bridge, यथा: in that way, बध्येत्: would build , तस्य: his, राक्षसराजस्य: rakshasa king's, ताम्: that, पुरीम्: city, यथा:like that, पश्येमः will see, तथा: that way, त्वम्: you, कुरु: think

40014162.author: Translation
40014162.content: "Raghava You think that we will be building a bridge and then seeing that city of the king of Rakshasas."

40014163.author: पदार्थः
40014163.content: त्रिकूटशिखरे: on top of Trikuta mountain, स्थिताम्: situated, ताम्: that, लङ्कांपुरीम्: city of Lanka, दृष्टवा: after seeing, युद्धे: in war, तु: you, दर्शनात्: on having a look , रावणम्:  Ravana, हतम्:  is killed, अवधारय: can determine

40014163.author: Translation
40014163.content: "If the city of Lanka situated on top of Trikuta mountain is seen, you can be sure that Ravana is killed."

40014164.author: पदार्थः
40014164.content: घोरे: dreadful, वरुणालये: abode of Varuna, सागरे: on the ocean, सेतुम्: bridge, अबध्वा: without building, लङ्का: Lanka, सेन्द्रैः Indra , सुरासुरैःअपि: even suras and asuras, मर्दितुम्: to crush, नशक्या: not possible

40014164.author: Translation
40014164.content: "Without building a bridge on that dreadful ocean, the abode of Varuna, it is not possible for suras or asuras accompanied by Indra also to crush Lanka."

40014165.author: पदार्थः
40014165.content: लङ्कासमीपतः up to Lanka, समुद्रे: on the ocean, यावत्: up to , सेतुः bridge, बद्ध: on building, मे: mine, सर्वम्: all, सैन्यम्: army, तीर्णम्:  crossed over, जितम् इति: like having won, उपधारय: consider, कामरूपिणः those who can assume any form, इमे: these, हरयः vanaras, समरे: in war, वीराः heroic

40014165.author: Translation
40014165.content: "On building a bridge over the large ocean up to Lanka, when all my army of vanaras can cross over, you may consider that you have won. These vanaras are heroic in war and can assume any form at will."

40014166.author: पदार्थः
40014166.content: लङ्कासमीपतः up to Lanka, समुद्रे: on the ocean, यावत्: up to , सेतुः bridge, बद्ध: on building, मे: mine, सर्वम्: all, सैन्यम्: army, तीर्णम्:  crossed over, जितम् इति: like having won, उपधारय: consider, कामरूपिणः those who can assume any form, इमे: these, हरयः vanaras, समरे: in war, वीराः heroic

40014166.author: Translation
40014166.content: "On building a bridge over the large ocean up to Lanka, when all my army of vanaras can cross over, you may consider that you have won. These vanaras are heroic in war and can assume any form at will."

40014167.author: पदार्थः
40014167.content: राजन्: O king, तत्: therefore, सर्वार्थनाशनीम्: that which destroys everything, विक्लबाम् agitated, बुद्धिम्: feeling , अलम्: enough, अस्मिन्: in this, लोके: world, पुरुषस्य: man's, शोकः sorrowful, शौर्यापकर्षण: valiance is lost

40014167.author: Translation
40014167.content: "O king, therefore enough of this agitated feeling which destroys everything. In this world the valiance of man is lost if he is sorrowful."

40014168.author: पदार्थः
40014168.content: मनुष्येण: by a human being, यत्:  just as, शैण्डीर्यम्:  heroism,  अवलम्बता: follows, कार्यं: task तु: you, महाप्राज्ञ: very wise, अस्मिन्:  in this, काले: world, तेजसा: courage, सत्त्वम्: valour, अतिष्ट: rise up

40014168.author: Translation
40014168.content: "Just as heroism follows a human being in this world on accomplishing a task, you who are very wise, should resort to courage and valour and rise up."

40014169.author: पदार्थः
40014169.content: शूराणाम्: among the valiant ones, महात्मनाम्: great, त्वद्विधानाम्: that method, मनुष्याणाम्:  by human being, विनष्टेवा: that which is destroyed, प्रणष्टेवा: or lost, शोकः worrying, सर्वार्थनाशनः leads to disaster of everything

40014169.author: Translation
40014169.content: "If you who are great among the valiant ones worry for that which is destroyed or lost, it would lead to disaster of everything."

40014170.author: पदार्थः
40014170.content: त्वम्: you, बुद्धिमताम्:  highly intelligent, श्रेष्ठः foremost सर्वशास्त्रार्थकोविदः wellversed in the meaning of all sastras, त्वम्: to you, तु: to you, मद्विधैः like me, सचिवैः friends सार्थम्: along with, अरिम्: enemy, जेतुम्:  conquer, इहार्हसि: you will

40014170.author: Translation
40014170.content: "You are highly intelligent, foremost among those who are wellversed in the meaning of all shastras. You will conquer your enemy along with friends like me."

40014171.author: पदार्थः
40014171.content: राघव: Raghava, रणे: when in war, गृहीतधनुषः holding the bow, ते: your, अभिमुखो: in front, यः who, तिष्ठेत्: stood by, कंचित्: indeed, त्रिषु: in the three, लोकेषु: worlds, अहम्:  I, नपश्यामिहि: have not seen

40014171.author: Translation
40014171.content: "O Raghava When you hold the bow in war, Indeed  who can stand in front of you in the three worlds. I have not seen."

40014172.author: पदार्थः
40014172.content: वानरेषु: upon vanaras, समासक्तम्: entrusted , तेकार्यम्: this task of yours, नविपत्स्यते: will not be spoilt, अक्षयम्: that which cannot be subdued , सागरम्: ocean, तीर्त्वा: crossing over, अचिरात्: very soon, सीताम्: that Sita, द्रक्ष्यसे: you will see

40014172.author: Translation
40014172.content: "The task of yours entrusted to vanaras will never be spoiled. Very soon you will see Sita crossing over the ocean that cannot be subdued."

40014173.author: पदार्थः
40014173.content: भूपते: O Lord of earth, तत्: that, शोकम्: pain, आलम्ब्य: experienced, अलम्: enough, क्रोधम्: anger, अलम्ब: take on to, निश्चेष्टाः become lethargic , क्षत्रियाः when kshatriyas, मन्दाः dull people, चण्डस्य: at fearful one , सर्वे: all, बिभ्यति: are scared

40014173.author: Translation
40014173.content: "O Lord of earth Enough of that pain you have experienced. Give up sorrow and take on to anger. When kshatriyas are lethargic, they become dull but all are scared at a fearful one."

40014174.author: पदार्थः
40014174.content: सूक्ष्मबुद्धिः one with subtle intellect, इह: now, अस्माभिःसह: along with us,उपेतः means , नदीपतेः lord of rivers, घोरस्य: dreadful, समुद्रस्य: of ocean, लङ्घनार्थम्: to cross over, विचारय: think of

40014174.author: Translation
40014174.content: "You are endowed with subtle intellect and now think of the means to cross over this dreadful looking ocean the lord of rivers."

40014175.author: पदार्थः
40014175.content: तैः these vanaras, सैन्यैः army, तस्य: for them, लङ्घिते: if they can cross, जितमित्येव: have conquered, मे: my, सर्वम्: all, सैन्यम्: army, तीर्णम्: certain , जितमिति: have succeeded, अवधार्यताम्: certainly, उपधारय: presume

40014175.author: Translation
40014175.content: "If the vanara army can cross (the ocean) you are certain that we will conquer. Presume that the army has succeeded."

40014176.author: पदार्थः
40014176.content: समरे: in combat, शूराः heroes, कामरूपिणः those who can take any form at their will, इमेहरयः these vanaras, शिलापादपवृष्टिभिः rain boulders and trees, तान्: those, अरीन्: enemies, विधमिष्यन्तिहि: would cut them to size

40014176.author: Translation
40014176.content: "Being heroic in combat, these vanaras can take any form at their will.They would rain boulders and trees on enemies and cut them to size."

40014177.author: पदार्थः
40014177.content: शत्रुनिबर्हण: exterminator of foes, वरुणालयम्:  abode of Varuna the ocean, कथञ्चित्:  by any means, वयम्:  us, सन्तरिष्याम: the enemy, युद्दे: in combat, तं: him(Ravana), हतमित्येव: has been killed , मन्ये: think

40014177.author: Translation
40014177.content: "O Exterminator of foes By whatever means the ocean is crossed by us, think that the enemy has been killed in combat."

40014178.author: पदार्थः
40014178.content: बहुधा: many, उक्त्वा: speaking, किम्: what use, सर्वथा: by all means, भवान्: to you, विजयी: victory, निमित्तानि: signs, पश्यामि: are seen, मे: by me, मनः in mind, सम्प्रहृष्यति: is highly delighted

40014178.author: Translation
40014178.content: "Of what use is speaking many words. By all means you will be victorious. I see signs of it and feel highly delighted in my mind." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेद्वितीयस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the second Sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic,the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
